TS014 no-nested-functions

A function is declared at the top level rather than inside another function, so the call graph stays flat.

languages: javascript odin python rust typescript
severity: warning
default: opt-in
group: stable
go: Go has no nested named function; a func literal is a lambda, which TS015 reports
zig: Zig has no nested function; a fn is legal only at container scope, so every inner function is a struct member

TigerStyle: "Use only very simple, explicit control flow for clarity."
NASA P10 Rule 1: "Restrict all code to very simple control flow constructs."
